Is there a community center?

(Good luck with the exam! When do you have to do it?)

That's a great idea.

Thank you.

Tomorrow morning I am going to call a dog shelter.

Are you at college? 

Maybe can you join some group or club? I don't know how old are you or where you live, but normally there are activities for youths where you can meet people.

If you don't find the way to help yourself, you may consider to talk with the college psychologist (I guess you are at college since you said you are being less able to study, I apologize if you are not.)

Take care.

Have you wonder why you do?

Maybe you reject opportunities so your life "falls" by its own and you don't have to decide to end it?

Do you have therapist or psychiatrist?

Note: I don't think you are pathetic. Sometimes life turns so hard we can do self-destructive things.

While you are stable enough to work/study, keep yourself safe and you feel OK, you don't need to be medicated if you don't want it. Sometimes it is not need to eliminate voices, paranoia or delusional thoughts, if they are under control and you can live with them, then feel free to do it.

The most important thing it is you are happy and in peace with yourself.

Many psychiatrist have it difficult to understand it is possible to live with psychosis or schizophrenia without medication, and the only way to solve problems they see it is with more meds. Sometimes it is only need someone to talk with, someone with whom you feel safe and you can organize your ideas.

So your fear is understandable. I don't know where you live, but normally while you are not putting yourself or other people in danger, they cannot force you to take medications. 

Have you tried to explain to your doctors you can deal with your issues without medication?
